India's Education Minister Resigns Amid Protests and Claims of Victory

Dharmendra Pradhan has resigned as India's Education Minister. Protesters, including the Youth Congress and AAP, claimed victory following his resignation. The Youth Congress put up hoardings in Delhi thanking Rahul Gandhi, while AAP protested in Srinagar over recurring paper leaks. The resignation occurred amidst protests and an anthem that reportedly played before the announcement. BJP ministers and leaders praised Pradhan's decision, citing "Nation Before Self."
